notes.claim: The sign % stands for per cent, which means out of 100, so 70 per cent means 70 out of every hundred.
In the UK the standard VAT rate is 20%, and most goods and services are charged at it.

sources.title: What is a percentage? - BBC Bitesize
sources.quote: The sign % stands for 'per cent' which means 'out of 100'.

sources.title: Calculating percentage using the decimal method - Introduction to percentages - 3rd level Maths Revision - BBC Bitesize
sources.quote: Per cent means 'per 100'. If 70 per cent of the population own a pet, this means that 70 out of every hundred people own a pet.

sources.title: How VAT works: How much VAT you must charge - GOV.UK
sources.quote: Most goods and services are charged at the standard rate of 20%.
